Q1: Which behavior should the keep_fixing round cap have once it is spent, for low/medium findings? (High, critical and unrated stay blocking with no waivers in every option.)
Choices:
A. Do what the issue says: convert low and medium keep_fixing to accept_with_followup (a waiver plus a deferred advisory). If the verdict terminalizes, record no waivers. Rewrite the #6539 medium test at 6261-6324, and change README.md, agents.md and the exhaustion-judge prompt so they no longer say "the cap never accepts a finding".
B. Convert only low keep_fixing to accept_with_followup. Medium keeps converting to fail, so the medium test at 6261-6324 stays as it is. Make the low tests (6391+) pass and add a docs exception for low severity.
C. Keep the current #6539 policy: low/medium keep_fixing still converts to fail. Change the #6729 low tests (6391-6414 and the mixed test at 6416+) to expect `fail` and no waivers. Leave the docs and prompt alone. (RECOMMENDED)
**Note:** Option C means the "Fix" text in this issue is not carried out. Choose A if #6729 was a deliberate decision to accept findings at the cap.
